item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders to pause and check your thinking, and that's the point. Perspective is a choice you make, not something that happens to you. Notice where you may be assuming the worst, or guessing what others think without asking. Those stories feel true, but they're often just stories. Replace one with something kinder and more accurate. Your action: before your next transition today, take one slow breath and ask, "Is this thought helping?"
